title: cyclosorus sulfureus
intro: Cyclosorus sulfureus, commonly known as the Golden Rake fern or Sulfurwort, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus sulfureus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
